title: Insurance Claim Repairs Rate Card — Hourly Rates for Unrelated-Damage Work by Scope
content:
Customer-pay repair of damage unrelated to the claim, added to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order, is rated by the hour. The hourly rate follows the scope written on the customer-pay addition consent — the labor hours written on that consent — and the repair order's class.

## Rate bands

| Labor hours written on the consent | Repair class of the repair order | Hourly rate |
|---|---|---|
| no more than 4.0 (touch-up scope) | any class | touch-up rate, USD 96.00 |
| more than 4.0 | a class that requires manufacturer-certified procedures: Certified Structural Claim Repair or Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | certified rate, USD 112.00 |
| more than 4.0 | any other class: Express, Standard, Major or Structural Claim Repair | panel rate, USD 104.00 |

**Clause.** An addition of no more than the touch-up scope of 4.0 hours takes the touch-up hourly rate of USD 96.00; an addition of more than 4.0 hours on a repair order whose class requires manufacturer-certified procedures takes the certified hourly rate of USD 112.00, because the added work follows the same certified procedures; any other addition takes the panel hourly rate of USD 104.00.

## Notes to the card

1. The scope test reads the hours on the consent itself, to one decimal place: 4.0 hours is within the touch-up scope, 4.1 hours is above it.
2. The class test asks only whether the class requires manufacturer-certified procedures. A Structural Claim Repair order does not, so an addition above 4.0 hours on it takes the panel rate.
3. Within the touch-up scope the class makes no difference: 3.5 hours on an Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair order takes USD 96.00, as it would on an Express Claim Repair order.

## Band lookup, hypothetical consents

| Consent hours | Class | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 4.0 | Certified Structural Claim Repair | USD 96.00 |
| 4.1 | Certified Structural Claim Repair | USD 112.00 |
| 4.1 | Major Claim Repair | USD 104.00 |
| 6.0 | Structural Claim Repair | USD 104.00 |
